project.name: Packaged Food Label Compliance Checker
legal_framework: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020

rules.requirement: The common or generic name of the commodity should be declared.
rules.legal_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(1)(b)
rules.applies_when: Applicable packaged commodity and no relevant exemption applies.
rules.notes: Food-specific labelling requirements must also be considered.

rules.requirement: The net quantity of the commodity should be declared in the applicable standard unit.
rules.legal_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(1)(c) and Rule 12
rules.applies_when: Applicable packaged commodity and no relevant exemption applies.

rules.requirement: The declared quantity should use the applicable unit of mass, measure or number.
rules.legal_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 12
rules.applies_when: A net quantity declaration is required.

rules.requirement: The retail sale price of the package should be declared as required by the applicable rules.
rules.legal_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(1)(e)
rules.applies_when: Applicable retail package and no relevant exemption applies.

rules.requirement: Consumer complaint contact details should be provided as required by the applicable rules.
rules.legal_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(2)
rules.applies_when: Applicable packaged commodity and no relevant exemption applies.
rules.notes: OCR may identify phone/email/address text but cannot reliably establish legal completeness.

rules.requirement: Applicable manufacturer, packer or importer identification and address declarations should be present.
rules.legal_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 10 read with applicable provisions of Rule 6
rules.applies_when: Applicable manufacturer, packer or importer declaration is required.
rules.notes: Applicability depends on the package and role of the entity.

rules.requirement: Required declarations should be in Hindi in Devanagari script or English; additional languages may also be used.
rules.legal_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 9(4)
rules.applies_when: Required package declarations are being assessed.
rules.notes: OCR language detection can provide an indication but should not be treated as definitive legal verification.

rules.requirement: The name of the food should be declared on the label.
rules.legal_reference: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, Regulation 5
rules.applies_when: Pre-packaged food.

rules.requirement: The list of ingredients should be declared where required.
rules.legal_reference: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, Regulation 5(2)
rules.applies_when: Pre-packaged food, subject to applicable exemptions.
rules.notes: Certain foods and package sizes have exemptions.

rules.requirement: Required nutritional information should be declared in the prescribed manner.
rules.legal_reference: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, Regulation 5(3)
rules.applies_when: Pre-packaged food unless an applicable exemption applies.
rules.notes: OCR can detect the nutrition panel but cannot reliably validate every numerical value.

rules.requirement: The applicable vegetarian or non-vegetarian declaration should be displayed.
rules.legal_reference: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, Regulation 5(4)
rules.applies_when: Applicable pre-packaged food.
rules.notes: Symbol detection is preferable to OCR alone.

rules.requirement: Applicable food additive information should be declared in accordance with the regulations.
rules.legal_reference: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, Regulation 5(5)
rules.applies_when: Where food additives are present or applicable.
rules.notes: Determining whether every additive declaration is legally correct requires product and additive context.

rules.requirement: The name and complete address of the brand owner should be declared as required.
rules.legal_reference: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, Regulation 5(6)
rules.applies_when: Pre-packaged food.
rules.notes: OCR can detect the declaration but cannot reliably verify address completeness.

rules.requirement: The applicable FSSAI logo and licence number should be displayed on the food label.
rules.legal_reference: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, Regulation 5(7)
rules.applies_when: Pre-packaged food subject to the applicable FSSAI licensing provisions.
rules.notes: Logo presence is better assessed using image processing; licence number can be detected using OCR.

rules.requirement: A batch number, code number or lot number should be declared on the label.
rules.legal_reference: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, Regulation 5(9)
rules.applies_when: Pre-packaged food subject to the applicable provisions and exemptions.

rules.requirement: Date of manufacture or packaging and expiry/use-by information should be declared as applicable.
rules.legal_reference: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, Regulation 5(10)
rules.applies_when: Pre-packaged food subject to the applicable date-marking requirements.
rules.notes: Shelf-life and product-specific context affect the exact requirement.

rules.requirement: Instructions for use, including reconstitution or safety-related directions, should be provided where applicable.
rules.legal_reference: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, Regulation 5(13)
rules.applies_when: Where instructions are necessary or applicable to proper use or safety.

rules.requirement: Applicable food allergens should be declared separately in the prescribed manner.
rules.legal_reference: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, Regulation 5(14)
rules.applies_when: Where an applicable allergen is present.
rules.notes: OCR alone cannot reliably determine whether every allergen requiring declaration is actually present in the product.

rules.requirement: Country-of-origin information should be declared where required for imported food.
rules.legal_reference: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, Regulation 5(12)
rules.applies_when: Imported food.

rules.requirement: The name and complete address of the importer in India should be declared for imported food.
rules.legal_reference: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, Regulation 5(6)(b)
rules.applies_when: Imported food.
rules.notes: Import status must be established before applying this rule.
